sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion at this exact site
sites.functional_impact_measured: FACS cell-surface expression: CR-CFC L191-V5 surface levels similar to untagged CR-CFC; GPI-anchored surface display confirmed. Function beyond surface trafficking NOT MEASURED for the V5-tagged construct.
sites.rationale: The construct name 'CR-CFC L191-V5' explicitly names residue L191 as the tag junction, confirmed by the companion 'L191stop' truncation that defines the same boundary. Python lookup of the canonical CFC1 sequence confirms residue 191 is L (Leucine) and residue 192 is R (Arginine), both within the extracellular span (26–223). CFC1 is GPI-anchored with no TM domain, so residue 191 lies on the extracellular face, ~32 residues upstream of the C-terminal GPI signal. The chimeric context (CR-CFC) makes this indirect for native full-length CFC1, but the CFC1 COOH-terminal domain is the portion carrying the tag and the residue is explicitly named. Chimeric construct CR-CFC L191-V5, containing the hCFC1 COOH-terminal domain, was expressed in cells with a V5-His tag placed after residue L191 of the CFC1 sequence; the companion truncation CR-CFC L191stop confirms L191 is the precise junction. FACS analysis showed cell-surface expression of CR-CFC L191-V5 comparable to the untagged CR-CFC control.

sources.claim: FACS analysis revealed that the cell-surface expression of both CR-CFC L191stop and CR-CFC L191-V5 proteins were similar to that of the CR-CFC protein ( Fig. 9 C ).

literature_notes: L1 (PMC3385650) describes a V5-His tag appended 'to the end of the GPI signal of hCFC1'. For GPI-anchored proteins the C-terminal GPI signal is cleaved at the omega site during GPI-anchor transfer; any tag appended downstream of the omega site is removed with the signal peptide and is therefore not surface-displayed. The paper's finding that GPI attachment is 'not affected' confirms the protein reaches the cell surface, but the tag itself is absent from the mature GPI-anchored form. L1 therefore does not qualify as a surface tag site and no specific residue is named for it, so it is not entered in other_positions either.
